camel_example: aliyun iot UpdateProductTopic --region cn-hangzhou --Desc resubmit_a_test_topic --Codec compress --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --TopicShortName resubmit --EnableProxySubscribe false --TopicId 8210000 --Operation PUB
description_en: Updates a specified custom topic category of a product
description_zh: 调用该接口更新指定的产品自定义Topic类
kebab_example: aliyun iot update-product-topic --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --desc resubmit_a_test_topic --operation PUB --topic-short-name resubmit --topic-id 8210000 --enable-proxy-subscribe false --codec compress --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateProductTopic

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If this parameter is unavailable, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The description of the topic category. The description can be up to 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: Topic类的描述信息。长度限制为100字符（一个汉字占一个字符）
parameters.name: desc

parameters.help_en:
The operation permissions of devices on the topic category. Valid values:

- **SUB**: subscribe.
- **PUB**: publish.
- **ALL**: publish and subscribe
parameters.help_zh:
设备对该Topic类的操作权限，取值：

- **SUB**：订阅。
- **PUB**：发布。
- **ALL**：发布和订阅
parameters.name: operation

parameters.help_en:
The custom category name of the topic category. A topic category contains the _productKey_ and _deviceName_ levels by default. Category levels are separated by forward slashes (/). The format is: `productKey/deviceName/topicShortName`.

> Each category name can contain only letters, digits, and underscores (_), and cannot be empty
parameters.help_zh:
设置Topic类的自定义类目名称。Topic类默认包含_productKey_和_deviceName_两级类目，类目间以正斜线（/）分隔，其格式为：`productKey/deviceName/topicShortName`。

> 每级类目的名称只能包含字母、数字和下划线（_），且不能为空
parameters.name: topic_short_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the topic category to modify.
This is the **TopicId** returned after you call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69649.html operation to create a custom topic category
parameters.help_zh:
要修改的Topic类的ID。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69649.html接口创建自定义Topic类成功后，返回的**TopicId**
parameters.name: topic_id

parameters.help_en:
If **Operation** is set to **SUB** (subscribe) or **ALL** (publish and subscribe), you can enable proxy subscription.
Valid values:

- **true**: enabled.
- **false**: not enabled.

After proxy subscription is enabled, when a device connects to IoT Platform, IoT Platform queries the topics with proxy subscription enabled and subscribes to the topics on behalf of the device
parameters.help_zh:
**Operation**为**SUB**（订阅）或**ALL**（发布和订阅），可开启代理订阅。
取值：

- **true**：开启。
- **false**：不开启。

开启代理订阅后，设备与物联网平台建连时，物联网平台查询已开启代理订阅的Topic，帮助设备完成订阅
parameters.name: enable_proxy_subscribe

parameters.help_en:
For Standard and Enterprise instances, you can enable data compression or decompression for custom topics.
Valid values:

- **compress**: compression.
- **decompress**: decompression.

For more information about the data compression feature, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/477405.html.

><notice>If **TopicShortName** contains wildcards (`+` or `#`), you cannot specify **Codec** at the same time. If data compression or decompression is enabled when a wildcard topic category is created, invoking this operation to create the topic category fails.
></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
标准型和尊享型企业版实例下，可开启自定义Topic数据压缩或解压缩。
取值：

- **compress**：压缩。
- **decompress**：解压缩。

数据压缩功能详细内容，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/477405.html。

><notice>**TopicShortName**传入通配符（`+`和`#`）时，不可同时传入**Codec**。如果创建通配Topic类的同时，开启了数据压缩或解压缩功能，调用本接口创建该Topic类会失败。
></notice>
parameters.name: codec
